interpretation: The uninterrupted two-profile spatial handoff was valid but did not remove the critical transient. No candidate was current-safe, safe through t=0.16, or sustained-safe under the frozen gates. The best ranked case, handoff t=0.12 with second shoulder width 0.40 and delta 0.30, crossed the +0.020% width gate at t=0.13 (+0.0220186%) but failed at t=0.14 with Jpk +0.115248% and width -0.0019803%, then reached minimum width -0.0212952% at t=0.16. Across t=0.12/0.13 spatial handoffs, the critical excursion moved only slightly, supporting a focused response-latency test rather than a broader geometry sweep.
claim_boundary: Normalized native M3D-C1 only; no reactor-scale or experimental stabilization claim.
new_job_rationale: Move the validated spatial-profile handoff earlier to t=0.09, 0.10, and 0.11 while holding the strongest tested second profile fixed, to test whether preemption/response latency can suppress the t=0.14-0.16 failure interval without changing the frozen acceptance gates.
